exceptions.name: lightningcss
exceptions.reason: Pulled in by vite under vitest. Dev tooling only, never shipped or modified.
Platform binaries of lightningcss, same reason.

exceptions.name: axe-core
exceptions.reason: Dev only, never shipped. The accessibility engine behind @axe-core/playwright in the component checks.

exceptions.name: @axe-core/playwright
exceptions.reason: Dev only, never shipped. Runs axe over Storybook stories in the component accessibility checks.

exceptions.name: caniuse-lite
exceptions.reason: Browser support data that Next ships in the dashboard's server build through browserslist; it is read at build and server time and never sent to browsers. Reviewed under CC-BY-4.0, which allows commercial use with attribution, given in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

exceptions.name: nodemailer
exceptions.reason: The SMTP client for @drefyn/email, pinned exactly and imported by one wrapper file. MIT-0 is MIT without the attribution clause, so it asks less than MIT. Named here rather than added to the allow list, so a new MIT-0 package still gets a look. Accepted by the owner on 2026-10-31.

forbidden.name: sharp
forbidden.reason: Optional image dependency of Next.js; its prebuilt libvips binaries are LGPL-3.0-or-later. The dashboard serves images unoptimized instead.
Prebuilt sharp and libvips platform binaries, some LGPL-3.0-or-later.
